name: Jeju Volcanic Island and Lava Tubes
description: Jeju is a volcanic island about 130 km off South Korea's southern coast, and this World Heritage Site covers three of its highlights. You can walk into the Geomunoreum lava tubes, with their dark walls and colourful mineral-coated floors. You can also climb Seongsan Ilchulbong, a fortress-like cone rising from the sea, or hike Mount Halla, Korea's highest peak, which has a crater lake.
